content: मुकुन्दः [मुकुम् दाति दा-क पृषो˚ मुम्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa. .²2 Quicksilver. .²3 A kind of precious stone. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the nine treasures of Kubera. .²5 A kind of drum. .²6 A kind of grain. .²7 (In music) A kind of measure. .²8 The resin of the गुग्गुल or कुरुन्द tree (Boswellia Thurifera); also मुकुन्दुः.
